sources.title: ikim-uk-essen (IKIM) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The Institute for Artificial Intelligence in Medicine (IKIM) brings together researchers from a number of disciplines to perform research, improve patient care and innovate training of tomorrow's physicians and AI scientists in healthcare. The institute is part of the University Medicine Essen and the University of Duisburg-Essen.
